## License record

The asset page currently links to Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal. The author states in the page comments that the earlier CC BY-NC link was a jam requirement and was replaced with the current license.

The downloaded package contains only the PNG spritesheet and no separate license file. Keep this source record and the retrieval date with the asset. Before public release, re-check the upstream page in case its declaration changes.

## Intended use

- Paper panel: light top information strip
- Wooden panel/background: outer frame or darker backing layer
- Small buttons and handles: optional secondary controls
- Do not edit the original file in place; create production derivatives elsewhere
